You will need:

  1. One corned beef - I prefer flat cut and generally use 2-3lbs

  2. Seasoning packet

  3. Water (enough to almost cover the brisket)

  4. Orrington Farms Beef broth base and seasoning (you can use any other powdered buillon you prefer)

  5. Beer (if you prefer, I do mine both with and without depending on my mood)

Corned beef goes in the crockpot, with the fat side up, using the full seasoning packet.

Cover almost completely with water and/or beer.

Sprinkle powdered bullion on top and into the water - roughly 2 tablespoons

Set 6-8 hours low, depending on the size of your brisket. 8 hours is typical for a roast that feeds a family of 4-6.

Bonus: Corned Beef Hash

3c cooked potatoes, diced small Onion finely diced Leftover corned beef finely chopped

Warm a few tablespoons of butter in a pan, sauté onion until soft. Add the combined potatoes/corned beef mixture. Compact into an even later and allow to brown over a medium - medium/low temp. About 15 mins. Flip. Cook other side 5-6 minutes to finish heating through. Serve!
